P7568.corridor_notes: 855km (sheet) / 863.06km (EIA cumulative mileage) Tongliang-Qianjiang trunk, the Phase 2 (二阶段) trunk of the 川气东送二线天然气管道工程川渝鄂段 (Sichuan-Shanghai Parallel Gas Pipeline, Sichuan-Chongqing-Hubei section). Runs from the Tongliang/Hechuan district boundary (Chongqing) through numbered valve chambers 9# (北碚区澄江镇) - 10# (合川区草街镇) - 11# (北碚区柳荫镇) - 12# (渝北区大湾镇) - 大盛站(渝北区统景镇) - 14# (长寿区葛兰镇) - 16# (垫江县砚台镇) - ...on through further Chongqing/Hubei counties (忠县, 云阳, etc. per the same table, not individually resourced here) - to the Qianjiang Distribution Compressor Station in Hubei. GEM's Status='construction' is consistent with this being the currently-building Phase 2 trunk (vs. the completed Phase 1 Weiyuan/Luxian-Tongliang segment and the still-public-comment-stage Phase 3 supply branches). This trunk is what my 7 sibling PIDs (P7581-P7587, Phase 3 local supply branches) tap off of.
P7568.researcher_notes: Both master EIA PDFs (环境影响报告书, not just the brief 批复 approval notices) for the 川渝鄂段 project are hosted on archive.org with full OCR text: Phase 1 (Weiyuan/Luxian-Tongliang trunk) at 034f-60b-7539c-46b-78f-68bcdf-4feb-9975, Phase 2 (this PID's trunk, Tongliang-Qianjiang, + the 4 major storage-facility branches) at 759f-1a-193815494692b-2742c-895d-53a-7. Both already existed as GEM's 'current_route_ref' in worklist.json but were unused before this research pass -- confirmed high-value primary sources, reused across all 8 of my PIDs. Table 2.2-22 in the Phase 2 doc is the authoritative valve-chamber/township location table for this trunk and is the anchor for locating 5 of my 7 branch PIDs' start points (12#, 9#, 16# directly; DAT4# and 6# via a separate sub-branch table / the Phase 1 doc respectively). ResearcherNotes on this row (and the 7 branch rows) says 'MZ: ...（二阶段）' -- based on the EIA's own phase breakdown (line ~2898-2905 of the OCR text, '二阶段建设铜梁-潜江段干线、和牢家坪老翁场储气库支干线、大英-安岳-铜梁支干线、铜锣峡储气库支干线、黄草峡储气库支干线；三阶段建设...供气支线'), THIS trunk (P7568) genuinely is Phase 2 scope, matching the MZ note -- but the 7 short branch PIDs (P7581-P7587) are Phase 3 (三阶段) '供气支线' scope, so the shared '二阶段' ResearcherNotes label on those 7 rows appears to be an imprecise carryover, not accurate to this EIA's own phase definitions. Documented here rather than corrected on the sheet.

P7581.corridor_notes: Short local gas-supply branch (供气支线) tapping the Phase 2 Tongliang-Qianjiang trunk at 12#阀室 in 大湾镇 (Yubei District) and running into Yubei District proper to serve local gas demand. The Phase 2 EIA explicitly lists this as one of the 8 Phase 3 supply branches: '8条供气支线管道包括重庆境内...渝北供气管道...分别分布于重庆市大足区、潼南区、璧山区、合川区、渝北区、长寿区、垫江县，湖北省巴东县，总长135.6km' (combined length of all 8 branches). GEM's ResearcherNotes label this '二阶段' (Phase 2); per the EIA's own phase breakdown these 8 named branches are Phase 3 (三阶段) scope -- see note under P7568.
P7581.researcher_notes: 12#阀室's identity/location is well-corroborated (exact table match + two nearby groundwater wells). The downstream end point is district-level only -- the branch-specific EIA (which would give exact terminus, e.g. a gas-supply station or distribution point in Yubei) is still in public-comment stage per the country notes and was not locatable via WebFetch/archive.org search (WebSearch budget for this session was exhausted before reaching this PID; relied on archive.org + Nominatim only).

Coordinate is the document's own precise GPS for the trunk's 嘉陵江 (Jialing River) crossing point at this location: '嘉陵江 重庆市北碚区澄江镇 29°55'47"N 106°23'2"E' (converted: 29.929722N/106.383889E). Note: 澄江镇 is in 北碚区 (Beibei District), not 璧山区 (Bishan District, this PID's END) -- confirmed by 8 separate corroborating mentions of '北碚区澄江镇' across the EIA text, so this is a genuine inter-district branch, not an intra-Bishan one.

P7582.corridor_notes: Short local gas-supply branch (供气支线) tapping the Phase 2 trunk at 9#阀室 in 澄江镇 (Beibei District, at the trunk's Jialing River crossing) and running into 璧山区 (Bishan District) to serve local gas demand -- crosses a district boundary (Beibei -> Bishan) despite the branch's common name referencing only the destination district. The Phase 2 EIA explicitly lists '壁山供气管道' [OCR for 璧山] among the 8 Phase 3 supply branches distributed across 大足区、潼南区、璧山区、合川区、渝北区、长寿区、垫江县、湖北省巴东县 (combined 135.6km). See P7568 for the Phase 2/Phase 3 labeling note.
P7582.researcher_notes: Start point is unusually well-sourced -- an exact river-crossing GPS coordinate from the EIA itself, not an inferred/geocoded proxy. Initially assumed (from background knowledge) that 澄江镇 was in 璧山区 since that is commonly cited as Bishan's seat; the EIA document consistently and repeatedly states '北碚区澄江镇' instead, so the working hypothesis was corrected to trust the well-corroborated document text -- the branch genuinely runs from a Beibei District valve chamber into Bishan District. End point is district-level only for the same reason as the other branches (Phase 3 branch-specific EIA not yet public).

P7583.corridor_notes: Short local gas-supply branch (供气支线) tapping the trunk near the Tongliang/Hechuan district boundary (旧县街道 area, Tongliang side) and running into 合川区 (Hechuan District) to serve local gas demand -- the near-boundary tap point is expected, since this branch's whole purpose is to feed Hechuan District right where the trunk crosses into it. The Phase 2 EIA explicitly lists '合川供气管道' among the 8 Phase 3 supply branches (combined 135.6km across 7 Chongqing districts + Badong County, Hubei). See P7568 for the Phase 2/Phase 3 labeling note.
P7583.researcher_notes: Unlike the other 6 branches, no specific numbered valve chamber matches this one's GEM start-location field ('Jiu County') -- 旧县街道 is well-attested in the EIA as a place the trunk crosses, but not tied to a named tap/valve point for a branch. Start coordinate uses a different one of the three nearby monitoring wells than P7568's boundary proxy (both sets of wells are within ~1km of each other in the same subdistrict) to avoid an artifactual coordinate collision between the two PIDs, while flagging that both branches plausibly originate from roughly the same physical area (the trunk's Tongliang/Hechuan boundary crossing). This is a real corridor-proximity finding worth a human look, not a data error to fix here.
P7583.blockers: No named valve chamber or tap point specific to this branch was found in either master EIA; start point is a best-available nearest-township proxy rather than a confirmed branch origin.

This matches GEM's 'Valve Chamber No. 4' (a differently-prefixed 'DAT'-series numbering specific to that branch, distinct from the plain '4#阀室' on the main Neijiang-Tongliang trunk, which is in Anyue County, Sichuan and does not match). No exact GPS given for DAT4# itself; coordinate is the nearest sourced township's groundwater well ('香炉村4组', unlabeled well ID) at 105.809E/29.857N in 卧佛镇 (Wofo Town), 潼南区 -- the first/westernmost of three townships (卧佛镇, 五桂镇, 寿桥镇) with sourced coordinates along this branch within Tongnan District; DAT4# sits ~24km upstream (west) of the branch's Tongliang compressor-station terminus, consistent with a position nearer 卧佛镇 than the other two townships, but this is inferential, not a confirmed 1:1 match.

P7584.corridor_notes: Short local gas-supply branch (供气支线) tapping the 大英-安岳-铜梁支干线 (a separate Phase 2 storage/interconnect branch, itself running from Daying/Anyue in Sichuan through Tongnan District to a Tongliang compressor station) at DAT4#阀室 within Tongnan District, then running further into Tongnan District (toward the district seat, Zitong Subdistrict) to serve local gas demand. The Phase 2 EIA explicitly lists '潼南供气管道' [OCR '漳南'] among the 8 Phase 3 supply branches (combined 135.6km). See P7568 for the Phase 2/Phase 3 labeling note.
P7584.researcher_notes: GEM's 'Valve Chamber No. 4' initially cross-matched to the wrong feature: a plain '4#阀室' exists on the main Neijiang-Tongliang trunk in Anyue County, Sichuan (Phase 1 scope), which does not fit this branch's Tongnan/Chongqing location. Careful cross-referencing found the correct match on the separate DAT-prefixed numbering used for the 大英-安岳-铜梁支干线 in the Phase 2 doc, located in 潼南区 as expected. The exact town for DAT4# (among 卧佛镇/五桂镇/寿桥镇) is not confirmed -- 卧佛镇 was chosen as the nearest plausible candidate by relative position along the branch, and this should be treated as an approximation, not a confirmed valve-chamber location.
P7584.blockers: DAT4#'s precise township (vs. district-level 潼南区) is inferred, not directly sourced; treat start coordinate as approximate.

P7585.corridor_notes: This is the 黄草峡储气库支干线 (Huangcaoxia gas-storage interconnect branch, one of the 4 major Phase 2 storage-facility branches, distinct from the 8 Phase 3 local supply branches) -- runs entirely within 长寿区 (Changshou District) from 黄草峡首站 (但渡镇) to 云台站 (云台镇), connecting the Huangcaoxia underground gas storage facility to the trunk network. FLAG: the EIA states this branch's total length as 39.24km, but GEM's LengthMergedKm for P7585 is 14.18km -- a significant discrepancy not resolved here. Possible explanations: GEM's figure may cover only a sub-segment of the full 39.24km branch, or the EIA's 39.24km may include compressor-station/lateral piping not counted in GEM's line length, or GEM's figure may simply be outdated/wrong. Flagging per standing rule 3 (don't silently resolve) rather than picking one explanation.
P7585.researcher_notes: Both endpoints are named-station matches (not township proxies) with nearby well coordinates, the strongest sourcing among the 7 branch PIDs. Despite the 'Changshou' label matching GEM's ResearcherNotes framing as a Phase-3-style '供气支线' name, this branch is actually one of the 4 Phase 2 (二阶段) storage-facility branches per the EIA's own phase list ('二阶段建设...黄草峡储气库支干线'), not one of the 8 Phase 3 local supply branches -- so unlike the other 6 non-trunk PIDs in this group, the existing 'MZ: ...(二阶段)' ResearcherNotes label is actually ACCURATE for this one. See P7568 for the general Phase 2/Phase 3 labeling note.
P7585.blockers: Length discrepancy (EIA: 39.24km full branch; GEM: 14.18km) unresolved -- see corridor_notes.
